fields.description: What this society calls this window of time: Weekday Mornings, Weekends, On-call. A society's own vocabulary, extended freely and never a literal in a source file.
fields.label: Availability Slot

fields.description: The stable business key, and the docname. An application's declared availability points at this key, so relabelling a slot never rewrites history. Nothing in this app branches on a slot value.
fields.label: Slot Key

fields.description: An inactive slot keeps the applications already declared under it but is no longer offered for new ones.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: When this window opens, as a time of day. Optional, and it is what turns a named slot into a question a deployment can actually ask: without it 'Weekends' is a label a volunteer chose, and with it a schedule saying Saturday plus this slot covers a real span of hours. A slot with no hours still works everywhere it worked before; it simply cannot answer 'is this person free on the afternoon of the 3rd'.
fields.label: Opens

fields.description: When this window closes. A slot whose close is earlier than its open is refused: an overnight window is two slots in every society that has one, because a single row spanning midnight would have to belong to two days at once and no reader of it could tell which.
fields.label: Closes

fields.description: What this slot covers, in the society's own words.
fields.label: Description
